confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Sri Lankan hill-country pricing; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than hotel anchors, which vary widely by season, property class, and tourist demand. Nuwara Eliya carries a hill-station premium over lowland towns, and July is in the shoulder-to-busy season. FX was taken from the RBA exchange-rates overview as surfaced in search results; the RBA page itself was not opened directly. A third-party site reports a 16 Oct 2026 figure of 0.6947, but it was not used because it is not on rba.gov.au and the RBA 15 Oct observation is the latest one confirmed by the search result.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on tourist hill-country towns in Sri Lanka such as Ella and Kandy, adjusted upward for Nuwara Eliya's hill-station premium and colonial-era hotel stock. Alcohol anchors (beer, cocktail, wine) reflect Sri Lanka's high alcohol taxes. Cocktail and wine were set relative to the beer anchor because direct knowledge of local menus is weak.
